items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: A banjo player, and him on the guitar, Snoozy. And George Morris was playing drums, and go over there on trumpet. Bix was playing my fourth trumpet.

ctx.x: You never tell him about Snoozy?

Ah, Snoozy Quinn? Never heard of him. Well, because he knew all about him. No, tell me about him. She wanted me to tell you what I know about him, see. We know that you know about Snoozy. Well, here's Snoozy Quinn. I know you, because he goes into the history and all the other stuff. But I know him too, and I didn't go into it. Well, I was living there then. Yeah, you were there. Right. Snoozy Quinn, see. He was delivering meat, you know. Buckaloosa, riding bicycle, see.
